name: HI Mobility Berhad
summary: HI Mobility Berhad, through its subsidiary, provides cross-border and local bus services in Malaysia and Singapore. The company provides scheduled bus services, chartered bus services, and other services, including repair and maintenance services; and rents advertising space. It operates through a fleet of approximately 813 buses, 4 depots, and 65 electric buses. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.
